purpose: Plan R37c: eight known-truth scenarios, each with one planted decisive uncertainty (the others narrow). Part 1 offline: does decision.value_of_information rank the planted input first; part 2 live: does the agent run the method and name the planted input as the next step.
oracle: independent of the engine: plain-R one-input-at-a-time EVPI (others held at their medians) on a closed-form one-sided z-test power, 200000 draws; checked in part1.R before freezing

grading.part2: agentRan: a vcr_simulate call of kind decision_value_of_information whose scenario gives the planted input a distribution; engineNext: that run's result names the planted input as the next step (read from the result); named: the final reply's last paragraph mentions the planted input's label (a closed vocabulary from inputLabels) at least as often as any other input's label; counted separately, never merged
